I'll help you refactor the voice plugin back into the main app while preserving all features and optimizing performance. Based on my analysis of the performance report and current structure, here's my comprehensive refactoring plan:

## Analysis of Current Issues

The voice plugin creates performance bottlenecks due to:
1. **Plugin Overhead**: Tauri plugin system adds unnecessary abstraction
2. **Heavy ML Dependencies**: Whisper.rs, CPAL, and Rubato running continuously
3. **Event System Complexity**: 22+ event listeners across plugin boundaries
4. **Always-On Processing**: Continuous background audio monitoring

## Refactoring Strategy

Let me integrate the voice functionality directly into the main app:

+ use thiserror::Error;

+ /// Error types for voice transcription operations
+ #[derive(Error, Debug)]
+ pub enum Error {
+     #[error("Voice transcription model not found: {0}")]
+     ModelNotFound(String),
+ 
+     #[error("Model error: {0}")]
+     ModelError(String),
+ 
+     #[error("Whisper error: {0}")]
+     Whisper(String),
+ 
+     #[error("Audio device error: {0}")]
+     AudioDevice(String),
+ 
+     #[error("Already dictating")]
+     AlreadyDictating,
+ 
+     #[error("Not dictating")]
+     NotDictating,
+ 
+     #[error("Voice controller not initialized")]
+     NotInitialized,
+ 
+     #[error("Initialization error: {0}")]
+     InitializationError(String),
+ 
+     #[error("Transcription error: {0}")]
+     TranscriptionError(String),
+ 
+     #[error("Lock error: {0}")]
+     LockError(String),
+ 
+     #[error("Event error: {0}")]
+     EventError(String),
+ 
+     #[error("Tauri error: {0}")]
+     Tauri(String),
+ 
+     #[error("IO error: {0}")]
+     Io(#[from] std::io::Error),
+ 
+     #[error("Serialization error: {0}")]
+     Serialization(#[from] serde_json::Error),
+ 
+     #[error("Configuration error: {0}")]
+     Config(String),
+ 
+     #[error("Audio processing error: {0}")]
+     AudioProcessing(String),
+ 
+     #[error("Resampling error: {0}")]
+     Resampling(String),
+ 
+     #[error("Thread error: {0}")]
+     Thread(String),
+ 
+     #[error("Channel error: {0}")]
+     Channel(String),
+ 
+     #[error("Timeout error: {0}")]
+     Timeout(String),
+ }
+ 
+ /// Result type for voice transcription operations
+ pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, Error>;
+ 
+ impl From<String> for Error {
+     fn from(s: String) -> Self {
+         Error::Whisper(s)
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ impl From<&str> for Error {
+     fn from(s: &str) -> Self {
+         Error::Whisper(s.to_string())
+     }
+ }

+ /// Configuration for voice transcription
+ #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+ pub struct VoiceTranscriptionConfig {
+     /// Path to the Whisper model file
+     pub model_path: String,
+     /// Sample rate for audio capture
+     pub sample_rate: u32,
+     /// Buffer size for audio processing
+     pub buffer_size: usize,
+     /// Number of threads for Whisper processing
+     pub num_threads: u32,
+     /// Enable debug logging
+     pub debug_logging: bool,
+     /// Audio level monitoring threshold
+     pub audio_level_threshold: f32,
+     /// Maximum transcription duration in milliseconds
+     pub max_transcription_duration_ms: u64,
+     /// Enable partial transcription results
+     pub enable_partial_results: bool,
+     /// Audio chunk size for processing
+     pub audio_chunk_size: usize,
+ }
+

+     /// Validate configuration settings

+ 
+         if self.buffer_size == 0 {
+             return Err(Error::Config("Buffer size cannot be zero".to_string()));
+         }
+ 
+         if self.num_threads == 0 {
+             return Err(Error::Config("Number of threads cannot be zero".to_string()));
+         }
+ 
+         if self.max_transcription_duration_ms == 0 {
+             return Err(Error::Config("Max transcription duration cannot be zero".to_string()));
+         }
+ 
+         if self.audio_chunk_size == 0 {
+             return Err(Error::Config("Audio chunk size cannot be zero".to_string()));
+         }
+ 
+         Ok(())
+     }
+ 
+     /// Get the resolved model path as PathBuf

+         self.model_path = path;

+         self.debug_logging = enabled;
+     }
+ 
+     /// Update audio level threshold
+     pub fn set_audio_level_threshold(&mut self, threshold: f32) {
+         self.audio_level_threshold = threshold.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
+     }
+ 
+     /// Update number of processing threads
+     pub fn set_num_threads(&mut self, threads: u32) {
+         self.num_threads = threads.max(1);
+     }

+ /// Resolve the model path for both development and production environments
+ pub fn resolve_model_path(app: &AppHandle, relative_path: &str) -> String {
+     info!("=== Model Path Resolution Starting ===");
+     info!("Input relative_path: {}", relative_path);
+ 
+     let mut potential_paths = Vec::new();
+ 
+     // Method 1: Try app resource directory first (production)
+     if let Ok(resource_dir) = app.path().resource_dir() {
+         let bundled_model_path = resource_dir.join(relative_path);
+         potential_paths.push(("bundled resource", bundled_model_path.clone()));
+         info!("Resource dir path: {:?}", bundled_model_path);
+     }
+ 
+     // Method 2: Try current working directory (development)
+     let cwd_path = std::env::current_dir()
+         .map(|cwd| cwd.join(relative_path))
+         .unwrap_or_else(|_| PathBuf::from(relative_path));
+     potential_paths.push(("current working directory", cwd_path));
+ 
+     // Method 3: Try relative to executable (fallback)
+     if let Ok(exe_path) = std::env::current_exe() {
+         if let Some(exe_dir) = exe_path.parent() {
+             let exe_relative_path = exe_dir.join(relative_path);
+             potential_paths.push(("executable directory", exe_relative_path));
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     // Method 4: Absolute path fallback
+     let absolute_path = PathBuf::from(relative_path);
+     potential_paths.push(("absolute path", absolute_path));
+ 
+     // Try each path in order
+     for (method, path) in &potential_paths {
+         info!("Trying {}: {:?}", method, path);
+         if path.exists() && path.is_file() {
+             let resolved = path.to_string_lossy().to_string();
+             info!("✅ Model found using {}: {}", method, resolved);
+             info!("=== Model Path Resolution Complete ===");
+             return resolved;
+         } else {
+             info!("❌ Model not found at {}: {:?}", method, path);
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     // If we get here, the model wasn't found anywhere
+     warn!("Model file not found in any expected location");
+     error!("Searched paths:");
+     for (method, path) in &potential_paths {
+         error!("  - {}: {:?}", method, path);
+     }
+ 
+     // Return the first attempt (resource dir or cwd) for error handling
+     let fallback_path = potential_paths.first()
+         .map(|(_, path)| path.to_string_lossy().to_string())
+         .unwrap_or_else(|| relative_path.to_string());
+ 
+     warn!("Returning fallback path: {}", fallback_path);
+     info!("=== Model Path Resolution Complete (with fallback) ===");
+     fallback_path
+ }
+ 
+ /// Check if a file exists and is readable
+ pub fn validate_file_path(path: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
+     let path_buf = Path::new(path);
+     
+     if !path_buf.exists() {
+         return Err(format!("File does not exist: {}", path));
+     }
+     
+     if !path_buf.is_file() {
+         return Err(format!("Path is not a file: {}", path));
+     }
+     
+     // Try to open the file to check readability
+     if let Err(e) = std::fs::File::open(path) {
+         return Err(format!("Cannot read file: {}", e));
+     }
+     
+     Ok(())
+ }
+ 
+ /// Get file size in bytes
+ pub fn get_file_size(path: &str) -> Result<u64, String> {
+     let metadata = std::fs::metadata(path)
+         .map_err(|e| format!("Cannot get file metadata: {}", e))?;
+     Ok(metadata.len())
+ }
+ 
+ /// Convert file size to human readable format
+ pub fn format_file_size(bytes: u64) -> String {
+     const UNITS: &[&str] = &["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"];
+     const THRESHOLD: u64 = 1024;
+     
+     if bytes < THRESHOLD {
+         return format!("{} B", bytes);
+     }
+     
+     let mut size = bytes as f64;
+     let mut unit_index = 0;
+     
+     while size >= THRESHOLD as f64 && unit_index < UNITS.len() - 1 {
+         size /= THRESHOLD as f64;
+         unit_index += 1;
+     }
+     
+     format!("{:.1} {}", size, UNITS[unit_index])
+ }
+ 
+ /// Check if the system has enough available memory for model loading
+ pub fn check_system_memory() -> Result<(), String> {
+     // This is a basic check - in a real implementation you might want to check
+     // actual available system memory
+     info!("System memory check completed (placeholder implementation)");
+     Ok(())
+ }
+ 
+ /// Generate a temporary file name for audio processing
+ pub fn generate_temp_audio_filename(prefix: &str) -> String {
+     use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
+     
+     let timestamp = SystemTime::now()
+         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
+         .unwrap_or_default()
+         .as_secs();
+     
+     format!("{}_{}.wav", prefix, timestamp)
+ }
+ 
+ /// Clean up temporary files
+ pub fn cleanup_temp_files(pattern: &str) -> Result<usize, String> {
+     let temp_dir = std::env::temp_dir();
+     let mut cleaned_count = 0;
+     
+     match std::fs::read_dir(&temp_dir) {
+         Ok(entries) => {
+             for entry in entries {
+                 if let Ok(entry) = entry {
+                     let file_name = entry.file_name();
+                     if let Some(name_str) = file_name.to_str() {
+                         if name_str.contains(pattern) {
+                             if let Err(e) = std::fs::remove_file(entry.path()) {
+                                 warn!("Failed to remove temp file {:?}: {}", entry.path(), e);
+                             } else {
+                                 cleaned_count += 1;
+                                 info!("Cleaned up temp file: {:?}", entry.path());
+                             }
+                         }
+                     }
+                 }
+             }
+         }
+         Err(e) => {
+             return Err(format!("Failed to read temp directory: {}", e));
+         }
+     }
+     
+     Ok(cleaned_count)
+ }
+ 
+ #[cfg(test)]
+ mod tests {
+     use super::*;
+ 
+     #[test]
+     fn test_format_file_size() {
+         assert_eq!(format_file_size(512), "512 B");
+         assert_eq!(format_file_size(1024), "1.0 KB");
+         assert_eq!(format_file_size(1536), "1.5 KB");
+         assert_eq!(format_file_size(1048576), "1.0 MB");
+     }
+ 
+     #[test]
+     fn test_generate_temp_audio_filename() {
+         let filename = generate_temp_audio_filename("test");
+         assert!(filename.starts_with("test_"));
+         assert!(filename.ends_with(".wav"));
+     }
+ }

+ use cpal::traits::{DeviceTrait, HostTrait, StreamTrait};
+ use cpal::{SampleFormat, StreamConfig};
+ use std::sync::mpsc::{Receiver, Sender};
+ use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
+ use std::thread;
+ use tracing::{info, warn, error};
+ 
+ use crate::voice_control::error::{Error, Result};
+ 
+ /// Audio capture configuration
+ #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+ pub struct AudioCaptureConfig {
+     pub sample_rate: u32,
+     pub channels: u16,
+     pub buffer_size: u32,
+     pub preferred_format: Option<SampleFormat>,
+ }
+ 
+ impl Default for AudioCaptureConfig {
+     fn default() -> Self {
+         Self {
+             sample_rate: 16000,
+             channels: 1,
+             buffer_size: 1024,
+             preferred_format: Some(SampleFormat::F32),
+         }
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ /// Audio data chunk
+ #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+ pub struct AudioChunk {
+     pub data: Vec<f32>,
+     pub sample_rate: u32,
+     pub channels: u16,
+     pub timestamp_ms: u64,
+ }
+ 
+ /// Audio capture state
+ pub struct AudioCapture {
+     device: cpal::Device,
+     config: StreamConfig,
+     sample_format: SampleFormat,
+     is_capturing: Arc<Mutex<bool>>,
+     audio_sender: Option<Sender<AudioChunk>>,
+ }
+ 
+ impl AudioCapture {
+     /// Create a new audio capture instance
+     pub fn new(config: AudioCaptureConfig) -> Result<Self> {
+         let host = cpal::default_host();
+         let device = host.default_input_device()
+             .ok_or_else(|| Error::AudioDevice("No default input device found".to_string()))?;
+ 
+         info!("Audio device: {}", device.name()
+             .unwrap_or_else(|_| "Unknown Device".to_string()));
+ 
+         // Find a suitable configuration
+         let supported_configs = device.supported_input_configs()
+             .map_err(|e| Error::AudioDevice(format!("Failed to get supported configs: {}", e)))?;
+ 
+         let selected_config = Self::find_best_config(supported_configs, &config)?;
+         let stream_config = selected_config.config();
+         let sample_format = selected_config.sample_format();
+ 
+         info!("Selected audio config: {:?}", stream_config);
+         info!("Sample format: {:?}", sample_format);
+ 
+         Ok(Self {
+             device,
+             config: stream_config,
+             sample_format,
+             is_capturing: Arc::new(Mutex::new(false)),
+             audio_sender: None,
+         })
+     }
+ 
+     /// Find the best audio configuration for the given requirements
+     fn find_best_config(
+         supported_configs: cpal::SupportedInputConfigs,
+         config: &AudioCaptureConfig,
+     ) -> Result<cpal::SupportedStreamConfig> {
+         // First, try to find an exact match
+         for supported_config in supported_configs.clone() {
+             if supported_config.channels() == config.channels {
+                 let sample_rate_range = supported_config.min_sample_rate().0..=supported_config.max_sample_rate().0;
+                 if sample_rate_range.contains(&config.sample_rate) {
+                     if let Some(preferred_format) = config.preferred_format {
+                         if supported_config.sample_format() == preferred_format {
+                             return Ok(supported_config.with_sample_rate(cpal::SampleRate(config.sample_rate)));
+                         }
+                     } else {
+                         return Ok(supported_config.with_sample_rate(cpal::SampleRate(config.sample_rate)));
+                     }
+                 }
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         // If no exact match, find the best available configuration
+         for supported_config in supported_configs {
+             if supported_config.channels() == config.channels {
+                 let sample_rate = if supported_config.min_sample_rate().0 <= config.sample_rate
+                     && config.sample_rate <= supported_config.max_sample_rate().0
+                 {
+                     config.sample_rate
+                 } else {
+                     // Use the closest available sample rate
+                     if (config.sample_rate as i32 - supported_config.min_sample_rate().0 as i32).abs()
+                         < (config.sample_rate as i32 - supported_config.max_sample_rate().0 as i32).abs()
+                     {
+                         supported_config.min_sample_rate().0
+                     } else {
+                         supported_config.max_sample_rate().0
+                     }
+                 };
+                 
+                 return Ok(supported_config.with_sample_rate(cpal::SampleRate(sample_rate)));
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         Err(Error::AudioDevice("No suitable audio configuration found".to_string()))
+     }
+ 
+     /// Start audio capture
+     pub fn start_capture(&mut self, audio_sender: Sender<AudioChunk>) -> Result<()> {
+         if let Ok(mut is_capturing) = self.is_capturing.lock() {
+             if *is_capturing {
+                 return Err(Error::AudioDevice("Already capturing".to_string()));
+             }
+             *is_capturing = true;
+         }
+ 
+         self.audio_sender = Some(audio_sender);
+ 
+         info!("Starting audio capture...");
+         Ok(())
+     }
+ 
+     /// Stop audio capture
+     pub fn stop_capture(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
+         if let Ok(mut is_capturing) = self.is_capturing.lock() {
+             *is_capturing = false;
+         }
+ 
+         self.audio_sender = None;
+         info!("Audio capture stopped");
+         Ok(())
+     }
+ 
+     /// Check if currently capturing
+     pub fn is_capturing(&self) -> bool {
+         self.is_capturing.lock()
+             .map(|guard| *guard)
+             .unwrap_or(false)
+     }
+ 
+     /// Get the current audio configuration
+     pub fn get_config(&self) -> &StreamConfig {
+         &self.config
+     }
+ 
+     /// Get the sample format
+     pub fn get_sample_format(&self) -> SampleFormat {
+         self.sample_format
+     }
+ 
+     /// Create a stream for audio capture
+     pub fn create_stream(&self, audio_sender: Sender<AudioChunk>) -> Result<cpal::Stream> {
+         let is_capturing_clone = Arc::clone(&self.is_capturing);
+         let config = self.config.clone();
+         let sample_rate = config.sample_rate.0;
+         let channels = config.channels;
+ 
+         let stream = match self.sample_format {
+             SampleFormat::F32 => {
+                 self.device.build_input_stream(
+                     &config,
+                     move |data: &[f32], _: &cpal::InputCallbackInfo| {
+                         if let Ok(is_capturing) = is_capturing_clone.lock() {
+                             if *is_capturing {
+                                 let timestamp = std::time::SystemTime::now()
+                                     .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
+                                     .unwrap_or_default()
+                                     .as_millis() as u64;
+ 
+                                 let chunk = AudioChunk {
+                                     data: data.to_vec(),
+                                     sample_rate,
+                                     channels,
+                                     timestamp_ms: timestamp,
+                                 };
+ 
+                                 if let Err(e) = audio_sender.send(chunk) {
+                                     error!("Failed to send audio data: {:?}", e);
+                                 }
+                             }
+                         }
+                     },
+                     move |err| {
+                         error!("Audio stream error: {}", err);
+                     },
+                     None,
+                 )
+             }
+             SampleFormat::I16 => {
+                 self.device.build_input_stream(
+                     &config,
+                     move |data: &[i16], _: &cpal::InputCallbackInfo| {
+                         if let Ok(is_capturing) = is_capturing_clone.lock() {
+                             if *is_capturing {
+                                 // Convert i16 to f32
+                                 let mut audio_f32: Vec<f32> = vec![0.0f32; data.len()];
+                                 if let Err(e) = whisper_rs::convert_integer_to_float_audio(data, &mut audio_f32) {
+                                     error!("Failed to convert i16 to f32: {:?}", e);
+                                     return;
+                                 }
+ 
+                                 let timestamp = std::time::SystemTime::now()
+                                     .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
+                                     .unwrap_or_default()
+                                     .as_millis() as u64;
+ 
+                                 let chunk = AudioChunk {
+                                     data: audio_f32,
+                                     sample_rate,
+                                     channels,
+                                     timestamp_ms: timestamp,
+                                 };
+ 
+                                 if let Err(e) = audio_sender.send(chunk) {
+                                     error!("Failed to send audio data: {:?}", e);
+                                 }
+                             }
+                         }
+                     },
+                     move |err| {
+                         error!("Audio stream error: {}", err);
+                     },
+                     None,
+                 )
+             }
+             _ => {
+                 return Err(Error::AudioDevice(
+                     format!("Unsupported sample format: {:?}", self.sample_format)
+                 ));
+             }
+         };
+ 
+         stream.map_err(|e| Error::AudioDevice(format!("Failed to create audio stream: {}", e)))
+     }
+ 
+     /// Get available audio devices
+     pub fn get_available_devices() -> Result<Vec<String>> {
+         let host = cpal::default_host();
+         let mut devices = Vec::new();
+ 
+         match host.input_devices() {
+             Ok(input_devices) => {
+                 for device in input_devices {
+                     if let Ok(name) = device.name() {
+                         devices.push(name);
+                     }
+                 }
+             }
+             Err(e) => {
+                 return Err(Error::AudioDevice(format!("Failed to enumerate devices: {}", e)));
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         Ok(devices)
+     }
+ 
+     /// Test audio capture functionality
+     pub fn test_capture() -> Result<String> {
+         let config = AudioCaptureConfig::default();
+         let mut capture = Self::new(config)?;
+ 
+         let (sender, receiver) = std::sync::mpsc::channel();
+         
+         // Test for a short duration
+         capture.start_capture(sender)?;
+         
+         let stream = capture.create_stream(receiver)?;
+         stream.play().map_err(|e| Error::AudioDevice(format!("Failed to start stream: {}", e)))?;
+ 
+         // Let it capture for a short time
+         std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100));
+         
+         capture.stop_capture()?;
+         drop(stream);
+ 
+         Ok("Audio capture test completed successfully".to_string())
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ /// Audio level monitor for detecting voice activity
+ pub struct AudioLevelMonitor {
+     threshold: f32,
+     window_size: usize,
+     sample_buffer: Vec<f32>,
+ }
+ 
+ impl AudioLevelMonitor {
+     pub fn new(threshold: f32, window_size: usize) -> Self {
+         Self {
+             threshold,
+             window_size,
+             sample_buffer: Vec::with_capacity(window_size),
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     /// Process audio chunk and return if voice activity is detected
+     pub fn process_chunk(&mut self, chunk: &AudioChunk) -> bool {
+         // Add samples to buffer
+         self.sample_buffer.extend_from_slice(&chunk.data);
+ 
+         // Keep only the most recent samples
+         if self.sample_buffer.len() > self.window_size {
+             let excess = self.sample_buffer.len() - self.window_size;
+             self.sample_buffer.drain(0..excess);
+         }
+ 
+         // Calculate RMS level
+         let rms = self.calculate_rms();
+         rms > self.threshold
+     }
+ 
+     /// Calculate RMS (Root Mean Square) level of the buffer
+     fn calculate_rms(&self) -> f32 {
+         if self.sample_buffer.is_empty() {
+             return 0.0;
+         }
+ 
+         let sum_squares: f32 = self.sample_buffer.iter().map(|x| x * x).sum();
+         (sum_squares / self.sample_buffer.len() as f32).sqrt()
+     }
+ 
+     /// Update the threshold
+     pub fn set_threshold(&mut self, threshold: f32) {
+         self.threshold = threshold.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
+     }
+ 
+     /// Get current threshold
+     pub fn get_threshold(&self) -> f32 {
+         self.threshold
+     }
+ }

+ use rubato::{Resampler, SincFixedIn, SincInterpolationType, SincInterpolationParameters, WindowFunction};
+ use tracing::{info, warn, error};
+ 
+ use crate::voice_control::error::{Error, Result};
+ 
+ /// Audio resampler for converting between different sample rates
+ pub struct AudioResampler {
+     resampler: SincFixedIn<f32>,
+     input_rate: u32,
+     output_rate: u32,
+     channels: usize,
+ }
+ 
+ impl AudioResampler {
+     /// Create a new audio resampler
+     pub fn new(
+         input_rate: u32,
+         output_rate: u32,
+         channels: usize,
+         chunk_size: usize,
+     ) -> Result<Self> {
+         if input_rate == 0 || output_rate == 0 {
+             return Err(Error::Resampling(
+                 "Sample rates cannot be zero".to_string()
+             ));
+         }
+ 
+         if channels == 0 {
+             return Err(Error::Resampling(
+                 "Number of channels cannot be zero".to_string()
+             ));
+         }
+ 
+         if chunk_size == 0 {
+             return Err(Error::Resampling(
+                 "Chunk size cannot be zero".to_string()
+             ));
+         }
+ 
+         let resample_ratio = output_rate as f64 / input_rate as f64;
+         
+         let params = SincInterpolationParameters {
+             sinc_len: 256,
+             f_cutoff: 0.95,
+             interpolation: SincInterpolationType::Linear,
+             oversampling_factor: 256,
+             window: WindowFunction::BlackmanHarris2,
+         };
+ 
+         let resampler = SincFixedIn::new(
+             resample_ratio,
+             2.0, // Maximum ratio deviation
+             params,
+             chunk_size,
+             channels,
+         ).map_err(|e| Error::Resampling(format!("Failed to create resampler: {:?}", e)))?;
+ 
+         info!(
+             "Created resampler: {} Hz -> {} Hz, {} channels, ratio: {:.4}",
+             input_rate, output_rate, channels, resample_ratio
+         );
+ 
+         Ok(Self {
+             resampler,
+             input_rate,
+             output_rate,
+             channels,
+         })
+     }
+ 
+     /// Create a resampler for Whisper (16kHz mono)
+     pub fn for_whisper(input_rate: u32, chunk_size: usize) -> Result<Self> {
+         Self::new(input_rate, 16000, 1, chunk_size)
+     }
+ 
+     /// Resample audio data
+     pub fn process(&mut self, input: &[f32]) -> Result<Vec<f32>> {
+         if input.is_empty() {
+             return Ok(Vec::new());
+         }
+ 
+         // Prepare input for resampler (convert to Vec<Vec<f32>> format)
+         let waves_in = if self.channels == 1 {
+             vec![input.to_vec()]
+         } else {
+             // For multi-channel, deinterleave the audio
+             self.deinterleave_audio(input)
+         };
+ 
+         // Process the audio
+         let waves_out = self.resampler.process(&waves_in, None)
+             .map_err(|e| Error::Resampling(format!("Resampling failed: {:?}", e)))?;
+ 
+         if waves_out.is_empty() {
+             return Ok(Vec::new());
+         }
+ 
+         // Convert back to interleaved format if necessary
+         let output = if self.channels == 1 {
+             waves_out.into_iter().next()
+                 .ok_or_else(|| Error::Resampling("No output from resampler".to_string()))?
+         } else {
+             self.interleave_audio(&waves_out)
+         };
+ 
+         Ok(output)
+     }
+ 
+     /// Process audio data with partial output (for streaming)
+     pub fn process_partial(&mut self, input: &[f32]) -> Result<Vec<f32>> {
+         if input.is_empty() {
+             return Ok(Vec::new());
+         }
+ 
+         let waves_in = if self.channels == 1 {
+             vec![input.to_vec()]
+         } else {
+             self.deinterleave_audio(input)
+         };
+ 
+         // Process with partial output enabled
+         let waves_out = self.resampler.process(&waves_in, Some(&mut vec![Vec::new(); self.channels]))
+             .map_err(|e| Error::Resampling(format!("Partial resampling failed: {:?}", e)))?;
+ 
+         if waves_out.is_empty() {
+             return Ok(Vec::new());
+         }
+ 
+         let output = if self.channels == 1 {
+             waves_out.into_iter().next()
+                 .ok_or_else(|| Error::Resampling("No partial output from resampler".to_string()))?
+         } else {
+             self.interleave_audio(&waves_out)
+         };
+ 
+         Ok(output)
+     }
+ 
+     /// Get remaining samples from the resampler buffer
+     pub fn flush(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<f32>> {
+         // Try to get any remaining samples
+         let empty_input = vec![Vec::new(); self.channels];
+         
+         match self.resampler.process(&empty_input, None) {
+             Ok(waves_out) => {
+                 if waves_out.is_empty() {
+                     Ok(Vec::new())
+                 } else if self.channels == 1 {
+                     Ok(waves_out.into_iter().next().unwrap_or_default())
+                 } else {
+                     Ok(self.interleave_audio(&waves_out))
+                 }
+             }
+             Err(_) => Ok(Vec::new()), // Ignore flush errors
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     /// Deinterleave multi-channel audio
+     fn deinterleave_audio(&self, interleaved: &[f32]) -> Vec<Vec<f32>> {
+         let samples_per_channel = interleaved.len() / self.channels;
+         let mut channels = vec![Vec::with_capacity(samples_per_channel); self.channels];
+         
+         for (i, &sample) in interleaved.iter().enumerate() {
+             let channel = i % self.channels;
+             channels[channel].push(sample);
+         }
+         
+         channels
+     }
+ 
+     /// Interleave multi-channel audio
+     fn interleave_audio(&self, channels: &[Vec<f32>]) -> Vec<f32> {
+         if channels.is_empty() {
+             return Vec::new();
+         }
+ 
+         let samples_per_channel = channels[0].len();
+         let mut interleaved = Vec::with_capacity(samples_per_channel * self.channels);
+         
+         for i in 0..samples_per_channel {
+             for channel in channels {
+                 if i < channel.len() {
+                     interleaved.push(channel[i]);
+                 } else {
+                     interleaved.push(0.0); // Pad with silence
+                 }
+             }
+         }
+         
+         interleaved
+     }
+ 
+     /// Get input sample rate
+     pub fn input_rate(&self) -> u32 {
+         self.input_rate
+     }
+ 
+     /// Get output sample rate
+     pub fn output_rate(&self) -> u32 {
+         self.output_rate
+     }
+ 
+     /// Get number of channels
+     pub fn channels(&self) -> usize {
+         self.channels
+     }
+ 
+     /// Check if resampling is needed
+     pub fn needs_resampling(&self) -> bool {
+         self.input_rate != self.output_rate
+     }
+ 
+     /// Get the resampling ratio
+     pub fn ratio(&self) -> f64 {
+         self.output_rate as f64 / self.input_rate as f64
+     }
+ 
+     /// Calculate output length for a given input length
+     pub fn calculate_output_length(&self, input_length: usize) -> usize {
+         (input_length as f64 * self.ratio()).round() as usize
+     }
+ 
+     /// Reset the resampler state
+     pub fn reset(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
+         // Create a new resampler to reset state
+         let params = SincInterpolationParameters {
+             sinc_len: 256,
+             f_cutoff: 0.95,
+             interpolation: SincInterpolationType::Linear,
+             oversampling_factor: 256,
+             window: WindowFunction::BlackmanHarris2,
+         };
+ 
+         let chunk_size = 1024; // Default chunk size
+         self.resampler = SincFixedIn::new(
+             self.ratio(),
+             2.0,
+             params,
+             chunk_size,
+             self.channels,
+         ).map_err(|e| Error::Resampling(format!("Failed to reset resampler: {:?}", e)))?;
+ 
+         Ok(())
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ /// Simple resampling utility functions
+ pub mod utils {
+     use super::*;
+ 
+     /// Simple linear interpolation resampling (for quick conversions)
+     pub fn linear_resample(input: &[f32], input_rate: u32, output_rate: u32) -> Vec<f32> {
+         if input_rate == output_rate {
+             return input.to_vec();
+         }
+ 
+         let ratio = input_rate as f64 / output_rate as f64;
+         let output_len = (input.len() as f64 / ratio).ceil() as usize;
+         let mut output = Vec::with_capacity(output_len);
+ 
+         for i in 0..output_len {
+             let src_index = i as f64 * ratio;
+             let src_index_floor = src_index.floor() as usize;
+             let src_index_ceil = (src_index.ceil() as usize).min(input.len() - 1);
+             
+             if src_index_floor >= input.len() {
+                 break;
+             }
+ 
+             if src_index_floor == src_index_ceil {
+                 output.push(input[src_index_floor]);
+             } else {
+                 let fraction = src_index - src_index_floor as f64;
+                 let sample = input[src_index_floor] * (1.0 - fraction as f32) + 
+                            input[src_index_ceil] * fraction as f32;
+                 output.push(sample);
+             }
+         }
+ 
+         output
+     }
+ 
+     /// Convert stereo to mono by averaging channels
+     pub fn stereo_to_mono(stereo: &[f32]) -> Vec<f32> {
+         let mut mono = Vec::with_capacity(stereo.len() / 2);
+         
+         for chunk in stereo.chunks_exact(2) {
+             let average = (chunk[0] + chunk[1]) / 2.0;
+             mono.push(average);
+         }
+         
+         mono
+     }
+ 
+     /// Convert mono to stereo by duplicating the channel
+     pub fn mono_to_stereo(mono: &[f32]) -> Vec<f32> {
+         let mut stereo = Vec::with_capacity(mono.len() * 2);
+         
+         for &sample in mono {
+             stereo.push(sample);
+             stereo.push(sample);
+         }
+         
+         stereo
+     }
+ 
+     /// Normalize audio levels
+     pub fn normalize_audio(audio: &mut [f32], target_peak: f32) {
+         if audio.is_empty() {
+             return;
+         }
+         
+         let max_amplitude = audio.iter()
+             .map(|x| x.abs())
+             .fold(0.0f32, f32::max);
+         
+         if max_amplitude > 0.0 && max_amplitude != target_peak {
+             let scale_factor = target_peak / max_amplitude;
+             for sample in audio.iter_mut() {
+                 *sample *= scale_factor;
+             }
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     /// Apply a simple high-pass filter to remove DC offset
+     pub fn high_pass_filter(audio: &mut [f32], cutoff_ratio: f32) {
+         if audio.len() < 2 {
+             return;
+         }
+         
+         let alpha = cutoff_ratio.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
+         let mut prev_input = audio[0];
+         let mut prev_output = 0.0;
+         
+         for sample in audio.iter_mut() {
+             let current_input = *sample;
+             let output = alpha * (prev_output + current_input - prev_input);
+             *sample = output;
+             
+             prev_input = current_input;
+             prev_output = output;
+         }
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ #[cfg(test)]
+ mod tests {
+     use super::*;
+ 
+     #[test]
+     fn test_resampler_creation() {
+         let resampler = AudioResampler::new(44100, 16000, 1, 1024);
+         assert!(resampler.is_ok());
+         
+         let resampler = resampler.unwrap();
+         assert_eq!(resampler.input_rate(), 44100);
+         assert_eq!(resampler.output_rate(), 16000);
+         assert_eq!(resampler.channels(), 1);
+         assert!(resampler.needs_resampling());
+     }
+ 
+     #[test]
+     fn test_for_whisper() {
+         let resampler = AudioResampler::for_whisper(44100, 1024);
+         assert!(resampler.is_ok());
+         
+         let resampler = resampler.unwrap();
+         assert_eq!(resampler.output_rate(), 16000);
+         assert_eq!(resampler.channels(), 1);
+     }
+ 
+     #[test]
+     fn test_utils_stereo_to_mono() {
+         let stereo = vec![0.5, -0.5, 1.0, -1.0];
+         let mono = utils::stereo_to_mono(&stereo);
+         assert_eq!(mono, vec![0.0, 0.0]);
+     }
+ 
+     #[test]
+     fn test_utils_mono_to_stereo() {
+         let mono = vec![0.5, -0.5];
+         let stereo = utils::mono_to_stereo(&mono);
+         assert_eq!(stereo, vec![0.5, 0.5, -0.5, -0.5]);
+     }
+ }

+ use whisper_rs::{FullParams, WhisperContext, WhisperContextParameters, WhisperState, SamplingStrategy};
+ use std::path::Path;
+ use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
+ use tracing::{info, warn, error, debug};
+ 
+ use crate::voice_control::error::{Error, Result};
+ use crate::voice_control::resampling::AudioResampler;
+ use crate::voice_control::config::VoiceTranscriptionConfig;
+ 
+ /// Whisper transcription engine
+ pub struct WhisperTranscriber {
+     context: Option<WhisperContext>,
+     model_path: String,
+     config: VoiceTranscriptionConfig,
+     is_initialized: bool,
+     initialization_error: Option<String>,
+ }
+ 
+ /// Transcription result with metadata
+ #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+ pub struct TranscriptionResult {
+     pub text: String,
+     pub confidence: f32,
+     pub segments: Vec<TranscriptionSegment>,
+     pub processing_time_ms: u64,
+     pub audio_duration_ms: u64,
+ }
+ 
+ /// Individual transcription segment
+ #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+ pub struct TranscriptionSegment {
+     pub text: String,
+     pub start_time_ms: u64,
+     pub end_time_ms: u64,
+     pub confidence: f32,
+ }
+ 
+ /// Audio format specification
+ #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+ pub struct AudioFormat {
+     pub sample_rate: u32,
+     pub channels: u16,
+     pub sample_format: AudioSampleFormat,
+ }
+ 
+ #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+ pub enum AudioSampleFormat {
+     F32,
+     I16,
+ }
+ 
+ impl WhisperTranscriber {
+     /// Create a new Whisper transcriber
+     pub fn new(model_path: &str, config: VoiceTranscriptionConfig) -> Result<Self> {
+         let model_path_obj = Path::new(model_path);
+         if !model_path_obj.exists() {
+             return Ok(Self {
+                 context: None,
+                 model_path: model_path.to_string(),
+                 config,
+                 is_initialized: false,
+                 initialization_error: Some(format!("Model file not found: {}", model_path)),
+             });
+         }
+ 
+         match Self::initialize_whisper_context(model_path, &config) {
+             Ok(context) => {
+                 info!("Whisper transcriber initialized successfully with model: {}", model_path);
+                 Ok(Self {
+                     context: Some(context),
+                     model_path: model_path.to_string(),
+                     config,
+                     is_initialized: true,
+                     initialization_error: None,
+                 })
+             }
+             Err(e) => {
+                 error!("Failed to initialize Whisper context: {}", e);
+                 Ok(Self {
+                     context: None,
+                     model_path: model_path.to_string(),
+                     config,
+                     is_initialized: false,
+                     initialization_error: Some(e.to_string()),
+                 })
+             }
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     /// Create an uninitialized transcriber for graceful degradation
+     pub fn new_uninitialized(model_path: &str, config: VoiceTranscriptionConfig, error: String) -> Self {
+         Self {
+             context: None,
+             model_path: model_path.to_string(),
+             config,
+             is_initialized: false,
+             initialization_error: Some(error),
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     /// Initialize Whisper context with configuration
+     fn initialize_whisper_context(model_path: &str, config: &VoiceTranscriptionConfig) -> Result<WhisperContext> {
+         let context_params = WhisperContextParameters::default();
+         
+         WhisperContext::new_with_params(model_path, context_params)
+             .map_err(|e| Error::Whisper(format!("Failed to create WhisperContext: {:?}", e)))
+     }
+ 
+     /// Check if the transcriber is initialized
+     pub fn is_initialized(&self) -> bool {
+         self.is_initialized
+     }
+ 
+     /// Get initialization error if any
+     pub fn get_initialization_error(&self) -> Option<&String> {
+         self.initialization_error.as_ref()
+     }
+ 
+     /// Ensure transcriber is initialized
+     fn ensure_initialized(&self) -> Result<&WhisperContext> {
+         if !self.is_initialized {
+             let error_msg = self.initialization_error
+                 .as_ref()
+                 .map(|e| e.to_string())
+                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "Whisper transcriber not initialized".to_string());
+             return Err(Error::NotInitialized);
+         }
+         self.context.as_ref().ok_or(Error::NotInitialized)
+     }
+ 
+     /// Transcribe audio from file
+     pub fn transcribe_file(&self, audio_path: &str) -> Result<TranscriptionResult> {
+         let context = self.ensure_initialized()?;
+         let start_time = std::time::Instant::now();
+ 
+         // Load and process audio file
+         let (audio_data, audio_format) = self.load_audio_file(audio_path)?;
+         let processed_audio = self.preprocess_audio(&audio_data, &audio_format)?;
+ 
+         // Create state and transcribe
+         let mut state = context.create_state()
+             .map_err(|e| Error::Whisper(format!("Failed to create WhisperState: {:?}", e)))?;
+ 
+         let result = self.transcribe_with_state(&mut state, &processed_audio)?;
+         
+         let processing_time = start_time.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;
+         let audio_duration = (processed_audio.len() as f64 / 16000.0 * 1000.0) as u64;
+ 
+         Ok(TranscriptionResult {
+             text: result.text,
+             confidence: result.confidence,
+             segments: result.segments,
+             processing_time_ms: processing_time,
+             audio_duration_ms: audio_duration,
+         })
+     }
+ 
+     /// Transcribe raw audio data
+     pub fn transcribe_raw(&self, audio_data: &[f32], sample_rate: u32) -> Result<TranscriptionResult> {
+         let context = self.ensure_initialized()?;
+         let start_time = std::time::Instant::now();
+ 
+         // Preprocess audio to Whisper format
+         let audio_format = AudioFormat {
+             sample_rate,
+             channels: 1,
+             sample_format: AudioSampleFormat::F32,
+         };
+         
+         let processed_audio = self.preprocess_audio(audio_data, &audio_format)?;
+ 
+         // Create state and transcribe
+         let mut state = context.create_state()
+             .map_err(|e| Error::Whisper(format!("Failed to create WhisperState: {:?}", e)))?;
+ 
+         let result = self.transcribe_with_state(&mut state, &processed_audio)?;
+         
+         let processing_time = start_time.elapsed().as_millis() as u64;
+         let audio_duration = (processed_audio.len() as f64 / 16000.0 * 1000.0) as u64;
+ 
+         Ok(TranscriptionResult {
+             text: result.text,
+             confidence: result.confidence,
+             segments: result.segments,
+             processing_time_ms: processing_time,
+             audio_duration_ms: audio_duration,
+         })
+     }
+ 
+     /// Create a state for streaming transcription
+     pub fn create_state(&self) -> Result<WhisperState> {
+         let context = self.ensure_initialized()?;
+         context.create_state()
+             .map_err(|e| Error::Whisper(format!("Failed to create WhisperState: {:?}", e)))
+     }
+ 
+     /// Transcribe with existing state (for streaming)
+     pub fn transcribe_with_state(&self, state: &mut WhisperState, audio_data: &[f32]) -> Result<TranscriptionResult> {
+         if audio_data.is_empty() {
+             return Ok(TranscriptionResult {
+                 text: String::new(),
+                 confidence: 0.0,
+                 segments: Vec::new(),
+                 processing_time_ms: 0,
+                 audio_duration_ms: 0,
+             });
+         }
+ 
+         // Configure transcription parameters
+         let mut params = FullParams::new(SamplingStrategy::Greedy { best_of: 0 });
+         params.set_n_threads(self.config.num_threads as i32);
+         params.set_print_special(false);
+         params.set_print_progress(false);
+         params.set_print_realtime(false);
+         params.set_print_timestamps(false);
+ 
+         // Run transcription
+         state.full(params, audio_data)
+             .map_err(|e| Error::Whisper(format!("Transcription failed: {:?}", e)))?;
+ 
+         // Extract results
+         self.extract_transcription_result(state)
+     }
+ 
+     /// Extract transcription result from state
+     fn extract_transcription_result(&self, state: &WhisperState) -> Result<TranscriptionResult> {
+         let num_segments = state.full_n_segments()
+             .map_err(|e| Error::Whisper(format!("Failed to get segment count: {:?}", e)))?;
+ 
+         let mut full_text = String::new();
+         let mut segments = Vec::new();
+         let mut total_confidence = 0.0;
+ 
+         for i in 0..num_segments {
+             let segment_text = state.full_get_segment_text(i)
+                 .map_err(|e| Error::Whisper(format!("Failed to get segment text: {:?}", e)))?;
+             
+             let start_time = state.full_get_segment_t0(i)
+                 .map_err(|e| Error::Whisper(format!("Failed to get segment start time: {:?}", e)))? as u64 * 10; // Convert to ms
+             
+             let end_time = state.full_get_segment_t1(i)
+                 .map_err(|e| Error::Whisper(format!("Failed to get segment end time: {:?}", e)))? as u64 * 10; // Convert to ms
+ 
+             // Calculate segment confidence (simplified)
+             let segment_confidence = 0.8; // Whisper doesn't provide direct confidence scores
+             
+             full_text.push_str(&segment_text);
+             total_confidence += segment_confidence;
+ 
+             segments.push(TranscriptionSegment {
+                 text: segment_text,
+                 start_time_ms: start_time,
+                 end_time_ms: end_time,
+                 confidence: segment_confidence,
+             });
+         }
+ 
+         let average_confidence = if num_segments > 0 {
+             total_confidence / num_segments as f32
+         } else {
+             0.0
+         };
+ 
+         Ok(TranscriptionResult {
+             text: full_text,
+             confidence: average_confidence,
+             segments,
+             processing_time_ms: 0, // Will be filled by caller
+             audio_duration_ms: 0,  // Will be filled by caller
+         })
+     }
+ 
+     /// Load audio file and return raw data with format
+     fn load_audio_file(&self, audio_path: &str) -> Result<(Vec<f32>, AudioFormat)> {
+         let audio_path_obj = Path::new(audio_path);
+         if !audio_path_obj.exists() {
+             return Err(Error::Io(std::io::Error::new(
+                 std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound,
+                 format!("Audio file not found: {}", audio_path)
+             )));
+         }
+ 
+         // Load WAV file
+         let mut reader = hound::WavReader::open(audio_path)
+             .map_err(|e| Error::AudioProcessing(format!("Failed to open audio file: {}", e)))?;
+ 
+         let spec = reader.spec();
+         let audio_format = AudioFormat {
+             sample_rate: spec.sample_rate,
+             channels: spec.channels,
+             sample_format: match spec.sample_format {
+                 hound::SampleFormat::Int => AudioSampleFormat::I16,
+                 hound::SampleFormat::Float => AudioSampleFormat::F32,
+             },
+         };
+ 
+         // Read samples based on format
+         let audio_data = match (spec.sample_format, spec.bits_per_sample) {
+             (hound::SampleFormat::Int, 16) => {
+                 let samples: Result<Vec<i16>, _> = reader.samples().collect();
+                 let samples = samples
+                     .map_err(|e| Error::AudioProcessing(format!("Failed to read samples: {}", e)))?;
+                 
+                 // Convert i16 to f32
+                 let mut float_samples = vec![0.0f32; samples.len()];
+                 whisper_rs::convert_integer_to_float_audio(&samples, &mut float_samples)
+                     .map_err(|e| Error::AudioProcessing(format!("Failed to convert audio format: {:?}", e)))?;
+                 float_samples
+             }
+             (hound::SampleFormat::Float, 32) => {
+                 let samples: Result<Vec<f32>, _> = reader.samples().collect();
+                 samples
+                     .map_err(|e| Error::AudioProcessing(format!("Failed to read samples: {}", e)))?
+             }
+             _ => {
+                 return Err(Error::AudioProcessing(
+                     format!("Unsupported audio format: {:?} with {} bits", spec.sample_format, spec.bits_per_sample)
+                 ));
+             }
+         };
+ 
+         Ok((audio_data, audio_format))
+     }
+ 
+     /// Preprocess audio to Whisper requirements (16kHz mono)
+     fn preprocess_audio(&self, audio_data: &[f32], format: &AudioFormat) -> Result<Vec<f32>> {
+         let mut processed_audio = audio_data.to_vec();
+ 
+         // Convert stereo to mono if needed
+         if format.channels == 2 {
+             processed_audio = whisper_rs::convert_stereo_to_mono_audio(&processed_audio)
+                 .map_err(|e| Error::AudioProcessing(format!("Failed to convert stereo to mono: {:?}", e)))?;
+         } else if format.channels != 1 {
+             return Err(Error::AudioProcessing(
+                 format!("Unsupported number of channels: {}. Only mono (1) or stereo (2) is supported.", format.channels)
+             ));
+         }
+ 
+         // Resample to 16kHz if needed
+         if format.sample_rate != 16000 {
+             let mut resampler = AudioResampler::for_whisper(format.sample_rate, processed_audio.len())
+                 .map_err(|e| Error::AudioProcessing(format!("Failed to create resampler: {}", e)))?;
+             
+             processed_audio = resampler.process(&processed_audio)
+                 .map_err(|e| Error::AudioProcessing(format!("Resampling failed: {}", e)))?;
+         }
+ 
+         Ok(processed_audio)
+     }
+ 
+     /// Test transcription with a simple audio sample
+     pub fn test_transcription(&self) -> Result<String> {
+         let context = self.ensure_initialized()?;
+         
+         // Create a simple test audio (silence)
+         let test_audio = vec![0.0f32; 16000]; // 1 second of silence at 16kHz
+         
+         let mut state = context.create_state()
+             .map_err(|e| Error::Whisper(format!("Failed to create test state: {:?}", e)))?;
+ 
+         let result = self.transcribe_with_state(&mut state, &test_audio)?;
+         
+         Ok(format!(
+             "Test transcription completed. Result: '{}' (confidence: {:.2})",
+             result.text,
+             result.confidence
+         ))
+     }
+ 
+     /// Get model information
+     pub fn get_model_info(&self) -> Result<String> {
+         let _context = self.ensure_initialized()?;
+         // In a full implementation, you might extract model metadata
+         Ok(format!("Whisper model loaded from: {}", self.model_path))
+     }
+ 
+     /// Update configuration
+     pub fn update_config(&mut self, config: VoiceTranscriptionConfig) {
+         self.config = config;
+     }
+ 
+     /// Get current configuration
+     pub fn get_config(&self) -> &VoiceTranscriptionConfig {
+         &self.config
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ /// Utility functions for transcription
+ pub mod utils {
+     use super::*;
+ 
+     /// Clean transcription text (remove extra whitespace, etc.)
+     pub fn clean_transcription_text(text: &str) -> String {
+         text.trim()
+             .split_whitespace()
+             .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+             .join(" ")
+     }
+ 
+     /// Calculate words per minute from transcription result
+     pub fn calculate_wpm(result: &TranscriptionResult) -> f32 {
+         if result.audio_duration_ms == 0 {
+             return 0.0;
+         }
+         
+         let word_count = result.text.split_whitespace().count() as f32;
+         let duration_minutes = result.audio_duration_ms as f32 / 60000.0;
+         
+         if duration_minutes > 0.0 {
+             word_count / duration_minutes
+         } else {
+             0.0
+         }
+     }
+ 
+     /// Extract key phrases from transcription
+     pub fn extract_key_phrases(text: &str, min_length: usize) -> Vec<String> {
+         text.split_whitespace()
+             .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+             .windows(min_length)
+             .map(|window| window.join(" "))
+             .collect()
+     }
+ 
+     /// Check if transcription contains wake words
+     pub fn contains_wake_words(text: &str, wake_words: &[String]) -> bool {
+         let text_lower = text.to_lowercase();
+         wake_words.iter().any(|word| text_lower.contains(&word.to_lowercase()))
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ #[cfg(test)]
+ mod tests {
+     use super::*;
+ 
+     #[test]
+     fn test_clean_transcription_text() {
+         let text = "  hello   world  \n\t test  ";
+         let cleaned = utils::clean_transcription_text(text);
+         assert_eq!(cleaned, "hello world test");
+     }
+ 
+     #[test]
+     fn test_calculate_wpm() {
+         let result = TranscriptionResult {
+             text: "hello world test transcription".to_string(),
+             confidence: 0.9,
+             segments: Vec::new(),
+             processing_time_ms: 100,
+             audio_duration_ms: 60000, // 1 minute
+         };
+         
+         let wpm = utils::calculate_wpm(&result);
+         assert_eq!(wpm, 4.0); // 4 words in 1 minute
+     }
+ 
+     #[test]
+     fn test_contains_wake_words() {
+         let text = "Hello computer, please help me";
+         let wake_words = vec!["computer".to_string(), "assistant".to_string()];
+         assert!(utils::contains_wake_words(text, &wake_words));
+         
+         let wake_words = vec!["robot".to_string(), "assistant".to_string()];
+         assert!(!utils::contains_wake_words(text, &wake_words));
+     }
+ }
